conventions.anchor: character game anchor = foot/ground point; damage/attack box z=0 at ground (calibration: rest damage box z 0..99px = feet-to-head ~174cm)
conventions.cm: pixel values multiplied by px_to_cm for UE planning; calibrated s=1.7615cm/px
conventions.position: frame position int16 pair = canvas placement relative to the owning object anchor; y-down screen convention (inferred; cross-checked: rest foot lands (0,3)px from anchor)
conventions.z_offset: named offset xyz = (x forward, y depth, z height) in game space relative to anchor; screen marker uses x right / z up

source.access: read-only (sqlite mode=ro); zero writes to DNFM tree
source.key_resolution: path_hash(xx64 of utf-16le lowercase path) -> scripts(shard,block) -> animations -> image_paths+frame_index -> atlas(lookup_hash)

shadow.conclusion: DNFM requests the shadow via per-animation draw_shadow=true (shadow_position=0); the visible blob shadow is drawn by the client view layer, not by an .ani sprite layer. For the UE replica: project a blob shadow at the foot anchor per the 07 plan (方案: 地面阴影另投射到脚下地面).
